items.title: Drink Purified Water
items.detail: Collect from a Water Purifier or Vintage Water Cooler at your C.A.M.P.

items.title: Collect a Fuel Tank or Gas Canister
items.detail: Found at industrial and roadside locations like Toxic Larry's Meat 'n Go.

items.title: Collect a Plunger
items.detail: Check the Whitespring Resort maintenance buildings or Wavy Willard's Water Park restrooms.

items.title: Complete a Daily Operation!
items.detail: Easier with a team; join or start a Daily Ops public team.

items.title: Craft a Grenade, Mine, or Thrown Weapon
items.detail: Use a Tinker's or weapons workbench at your C.A.M.P. or Whitespring Resort.

items.title: Kill a Lost
items.detail: Fast travel to Slumber Mill Motel in Skyline Valley and head north to the Red Rocket.

items.title: Kill a Pint-Sized Phantom during a Daily Operation!
items.detail: These masked cultists appear in Daily Ops during the Slasher event.

items.title: Drink Tea
items.detail: Use a Company Tea generator at your C.A.M.P. or collect tea elsewhere.

items.title: Kill a Mole Miner
items.detail: Fast travel to Blackwater Mine for reliable spawn.

items.title: Kill a Pint-Sized Phantom during a Daily Operation while on a Team!
items.detail: You can be the only person on the team and still get credit.

items.title: Kill a Rusted Deathclaw
items.detail: Find them at Dino Peaks Mini Golf; target the belly with V.A.T.S.

items.title: Kill an Uninvited Pint-Sized Phantom
items.detail: Completes Mischief Night event, then stay at Rapidan Camp where the Phantom spawns.

items.title: Scrap junk to produce Aluminum
items.detail: Craft Bulk Aluminum at a Tinker's Workbench, then scrap it.

items.title: Scrap junk to produce Antiseptic
items.detail: Scrap Abraxo cleaner, Industrial solvent, or Tick blood sacs.

items.title: Sell Mirelurk Queen Steak to an NPC vendor
items.detail: Find Mirelurk Queens at Mac's Farm or Spruce Knob Lake.

items.title: Travel on foot (KM)
items.detail: Fast travel does not count; sprinting on foot builds distance faster.

events.name: Slasher C.A.M.P. Contest
events.description: Build a slasher-themed C.A.M.P. or Shelter and submit it for a chance to win Atoms and exclusive titles.

events.name: Mischief Night
events.description: Participate in the Mischief Night public event to face Pint-Sized Phantoms and earn seasonal rewards.

events.name: Double Mutations
events.description: Encounter double mutation chances on creatures during this weekend event.

events.name: Spooky Scorched
events.description: Hunt Spooky Scorched enemies and collect seasonal rewards during this spooky-themed event.

events.name: Double XP
events.description: Earn double experience points for all activities to level up and progress faster.

events.name: Seasonal Fish Run Weekend
events.description: Increased chance to catch seasonal fish this weekend in fishing locations.
